title: First Battle of Cannanore
summary: The English Wikipedia article "First Battle of Cannanore", at revision 1370618501, opens: "The First Battle of Cannanore was a naval engagement between the Third Portuguese Armada under João da Nova and the naval forces of Calicut, which had been assembled by the Zamorin against the Portuguese in order to prevent their return to Portugal." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5452504, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Portuguese battles in the Indian Ocean". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
